summary: /music play now attaches a Skip / Pause-Resume / Stop control panel to its reply, instead of requiring the slash commands for everything after the first one.
details: The panel edits itself in place on every click (Now playing updates, Pause becomes Resume and back), rather than posting a fresh reply per action.
Calls the exact same MusicPlayerManager methods the slash commands use -- no second control path.
Buttons disable themselves after 15 minutes of inactivity, or immediately if playback stops.
limitations: Each /music play call gets its own panel -- queuing several tracks in a row produces several panels, all controlling the same shared session.
